rationale: unit:given.syntax distinguishes the source path p, and unit:given.state defines object identities and storage; this unit introduces storage-place q and lookup/update notation before their operational use. StoragePlace has exactly variable name and field object name. Stored uses membership for variables and existential object-data plus field membership for fields, matching the two partial-lookup clauses under the finite-map assumptions from given.state. Option none distinguishes an existing empty slot from absent entries. Updated decomposes the existing variable list or an existing object's field list, replaces only that slot's contents, and preserves all prefixes/suffixes, class names, other tables, and nextId. It works for arbitrary replacement Slot values including none, and does not create missing variables, objects, or fields. An object identity in a slot is distinct from the Object data in the object table.
